cohort: Preterm infants born at or before 32 weeks of gestation who underwent placental pathology evaluation and were followed-up at 18-24 months of corrected age.
finding: Moderate-severe Histological chorioamnionitis (HCA) was associated with increased early-onset sepsis, severe intraventricular haemorrhage, and poor long-term outcomes including cognitive impairment and cerebral palsy.
